description: Magento 2 / Mage-OS module (MageOS_DigitalSignature) that generates contract PDFs from order data and sends them for e-signature through pluggable providers (wSign, DocuSign, Adobe Acrobat Sign, custom). Includes order/invoice triggers, merge fields, a REST API, HMAC-signed outbound webhooks, provider quotas and GDPR retention.
rules: Register a new signature provider by adding an item to MageOS\DigitalSignature\Model\Provider\Pool in your own module's di.xml; never edit the core module.
Connectors implement SignProviderInterface, return StartResult/StatusResult DTOs and never write to the document or the storage.
In mapStatus(), call ProviderConfig::mapConfiguredStatus() first and return only MageOS\DigitalSignature\Model\Document\Status constants or null.
Throw ProviderException::retryable() for transient errors (network, 5xx, 429) and ProviderException::permanent() for everything else.
Add merge fields by implementing MergeFieldProviderInterface and registering it in MageOS\DigitalSignature\Model\MergeField\Pool; the di.xml item name is the {FIELD:code} used in the PDF.
Verify outbound webhooks with HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body against the X-Signature header (sha256=<hex>) and deduplicate on delivery_id.
POST /V1/digitalsignature/orders/:orderId/documents/generate only runs templates whose trigger is manual.
Configuration paths start with digital_signature/; provider settings are digital_signature/providers/<code>/<field>.
Documents are processed asynchronously: the digitalsignatureDocumentProcess, digitalsignatureDocumentRefresh and digitalsignatureWebhookDispatch consumers and cron must run.
